# IonDomo - Parental Control & Digital Wellbeing System

## Product Overview
IonDomo is an enterprise-grade parental control and digital wellbeing platform developed by IONKOD. It helps parents and legal guardians monitor and manage their children's digital device usage with transparency, security, and LGPD compliance.

## Key Features
- **Screen Time Management**: Set daily limits, schedules, and app-specific restrictions
- **Content Filtering**: Block inappropriate websites and apps
- **Usage Analytics**: Track app usage, screen time, and digital habits
- **Encrypted Telemetry**: All data is encrypted end-to-end (AES-256-GCM + RSA-2048)
- **LGPD Compliant**: Full compliance with Brazilian data protection law, especially Article 14 (children's data)

## Technology Stack
- **Mobile Agent**: Android (Kotlin), AndroidX Security, WorkManager
- **Backend API**: [To be defined - Go/Node.js/Python]
- **Database**: PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB (time-series metrics)
- **Security**: End-to-end encryption, OAuth2, MFA
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions with automated security audits

## Security & Compliance
- No hardcoded secrets (all credentials in environment variables)
- Automated security scanning (gitleaks, static analysis)
- LGPD compliance with parental consent (Art. 14)
- Data minimization principle
- Right to deletion (data retention: 90 days)

## Target Audience
- Parents and legal guardians of children and adolescents
- Families seeking digital wellbeing solutions
- Educational institutions (future roadmap)

## Important Notes
- This product is designed for LEGAL parental monitoring only
- Monitoring adults without consent is strictly prohibited
- All data collection requires explicit parental consent
- Children's data is treated with maximum security and privacy
